画面饱满而题跋克制，自信从容，不多言语: Full composition with a restrained inscription — confident and composed, letting the painting speak
此画尺幅宏大，或为进呈之作，体现宫廷画家对正式场合的创作态度。: The imposing format suggests a presentation piece, reflecting the court painter's attitude toward formal occasions.
大幅立轴常见于中期卖画生涯，既展示笔墨功力，也对应更高润格。: Large hanging scrolls were common in his mid-career selling years — showcasing brush skill while commanding higher prices.
晚年仍作大幅，或出于对世事的未甘，借大笔挥洒寄寓复杂心绪。: Still painting large formats in his late years — perhaps out of unfinished longing for the world, pouring complex feelings into sweeping strokes.
标准立轴尺寸，是李鱓最常用的形制，兼顾展示效果与创作效率。: Standard hanging-scroll size, Li Shan's most common format — balancing display impact with working efficiency.
册页形制便于呈览，符合宫廷画家'应制'或进呈的功能需求。: The album format suited presentation at court, fitting a court painter's commissioned or tribute work.
小景多为案头清玩，或作友人间的笔墨唱和。: Small scenes were mostly desk amusements, or brush exchanges among friends.
晚年小品多为墨戏，题材日常，笔墨恣肆，是归隐后抒发性灵的载体。: Late small works are mostly ink play — everyday subjects and free brushwork, vehicles for his reclusive spirit.

仕途受挫，卖画为生: Official career thwarted; lived by selling paintings
题跋谨慎，生活困顿，衰年变法: Inscriptions grew cautious, life hardened — a late-years style reform
供奉内廷之荣: The honor of serving the inner court
辞官后卖画为生: Resigned office to live by selling paintings
不甘被视作画匠，傲骨抗争: Refusing to be seen as a mere craftsman — defiant pride
以画自立、不媚权贵: Standing on his art alone, never fawning on the powerful
不为五斗米折腰，清高自持: 'Never bowing for five pecks of rice' — aloof integrity
苦涩自况，以苦李自喻: Bitter self-portraiture, likening himself to a bitter plum
自得其乐，超然物外: Content in his own joy, aloof from the world
豁达开朗，笑对人生: Open-hearted, facing life with a laugh
笔墨消磨人生，感叹时光: 'Ink grinds the man down' — a sigh over passing time
爱石成癖，文人雅趣: A craze for rocks — literati refinement
书画雅兴，沉浸墨池: Refined delight in painting and calligraphy, immersed in ink
未收录印章，按中性处理: Seal not in the catalog; treated as neutral
借画/题跋映射自身境遇、身份认同、人生感慨。: Paintings and inscriptions mirroring his own circumstances, identity and reflections on life.
借所画之物抒发情志、寄托品格理想。: Investing painted objects with feeling and ideals of character.

批判社会现实、关怀民生疾苦、讽刺权贵世态。: Critiquing society, sympathizing with the people's hardships, satirizing the powerful.
